intro.title: Company Profile
intro.p1: Hengli Precision Spring & Stamping Co., Ltd. was founded in 2005, headquartered in Dongguan City, Guangdong Province. We are a professional precision elastic component manufacturer integrating R&D, production, and sales. Our facility covers 8,000 square meters with over 200 employees, including 30+ engineering technicians.
intro.p2: Since our establishment, we have adhered to the philosophy of 'innovation as life, quality as survival', continuously introducing advanced production equipment and inspection instruments from domestic and international sources to enhance our manufacturing capability and quality standards.
intro.p3: With an annual capacity exceeding 200 million parts, our products are widely used in automotive manufacturing, 3C electronics, home appliances, medical devices, and new energy sectors, exported to 30+ countries and regions worldwide.

items.event: Company founded, leasing 1,200㎡ facility, starting spring processing business
Purchased 3,000㎡ factory, introduced automatic spring coiler production lines
ISO 9001 certified, expanded into overseas markets
Facility expanded to 8,000㎡, obtained IATF 16949 automotive certification
Introduced MIM metal injection molding technology, expanded precision parts business
Annual capacity exceeded 200M parts, serving 30+ countries and regions

products.title: Products
products.subtitle: One-stop custom manufacturing services for springs, contacts, and elastic components

categories.name: Compression Springs
categories.desc: Using imported spring wire with Taiwanese CNC automatic spring coilers, producing compression springs from 0.1mm to 20mm wire diameter. Features include excellent linearity, long fatigue life, and consistent dimensions. Suitable for automotive suspensions, valves, electronics, and industrial machinery. Supports end grinding, chamfering, and heat setting.
specs: Materials: Carbon steel, Alloy steel, Stainless steel, Copper alloy

categories.name: Tension Springs
categories.desc: Precision tension springs manufactured with automated continuous forming process, ensuring consistent tension across every batch. Supports multiple loop styles (English, German, cross-over, side, inner hook) with custom orientations.
specs: Materials: Carbon steel, Stainless steel, Music wire

categories.name: Torsion Springs
categories.desc: Precision torsion springs with tight torque tolerance control for precision assembly. Capable of producing double torsion, single torsion, and complex shaped torsion springs.
specs: Materials: Carbon steel, Stainless steel, Alloy steel

categories.name: Custom-Shaped Springs
categories.desc: Non-standard custom elastic components designed and manufactured based on customer drawings, samples, or functional requirements. FEA-assisted design optimizes stress distribution for reliability under complex conditions.

categories.name: Stamping Contacts
categories.desc: Precision stamping contacts produced on 25T-200T precision presses with high-speed stamping lines. Includes contact clips, EMI shielding springs, retaining clips, wave springs, and more.
